rows.role_title: President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: At the 91st extraordinary deliberative session of 17 April 2016 the Chamber voted on the special committee's opinion (admissibility of the accusation against the President and authorization for the Senate to institute proceedings for a crime of responsibility): yes 367, no 137, abstentions 7, absent 2, total 511. The presiding officer (Eduardo Cunha) declared the institution of proceedings against the President authorized and said the decision would be communicated to the President of the Senate under art. 52, I of the Constitution.

locator.passage: 'Resultado da votação' through 'A decisão será comunicada ao Sr. Presidente do Senado Federal'

bounded_scope: Head-of-state observations for CLAUDE-C01-10 only. Election, diplomação, oath, posse, termo de posse, sash ceremony, authorization, summons, suspension, the Vice-President's exercise, resignation, vacancy, judgment, removal and disqualification stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row. Vice-presidents, ministers and party offices are excluded except the Vice-President's exercise of the office, recorded as rows only.
